chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Used for basic chat functionality and integration with various external tools. This is the model you talk to.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: This is a model that usually runs in the background and notifies you when it's done, only used for reasoning and complex, problem-solving tasks.

copywriting.title: Copywriting
copywriting.description: This is a model that is used for copywriting, content creation, spelling and grammar corrections, as well as various other tasks that require style and tone adjustments.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: This is a model that is used for vision tasks, such as image classification, image understanding, and chatting with images. This is what is used when you upload an image to the chat.

hearing.title: Hearing
hearing.description: This is a model that is used for hearing tasks, such as speech recognition, speech-to-text, natural language understanding, and chatting with audio. This is what is used when you upload an audio file to the chat.

images_gen.title: Image Generation & Editing
images_gen.description: This model creates images from text prompts and edits reference images.

search.title: Search
search.description: This is a model that is used for web search, such as searching the web for information, news, products, services, or background research on a topic not known to your chat companion.

embedding.title: Embedding
embedding.description: This is a model that is used for embedding, such as embedding text, images, or audio into a vector space. It's used for similarity search across internal databases, documents, and other semantic search tasks. This is used when you upload a PDF file to the chat.

help_page.intro_title: Get {botName} working the way you expect.
help_page.intro_description: Choose the outcome you want. Each guide explains what to configure, what changes behind the scenes, and where to go next.
help_page.principle_title: Ask by outcome. Configure by capability.
help_page.principle_description: You work with {botName} in chat. Settings decide which tools, access path, and rules support each task.
help_page.setup_locked: You can use Help while setting up your account. Regular settings remain locked until the required policies are accepted.

setup.title: Set up {botName} only once
setup.summary: Use Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, and other supported models without creating a separate account with each of their providers.
setup.example: I want one assistant for Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, and other services—not a separate setup for each one.
setup.guide: Set up your {botName} profile, context, and preferences once. Use credits to access supported providers without managing individual API keys, or connect your own keys if you prefer BYOK. In “Intelligence,” choose the best model for each capability while {botName} keeps the same identity and behavior across all providers.
setup.note: Availability and costs differ among providers. For BYOK: adding an API key makes that provider available but does not automatically select its models; models are still selected in “Intelligence.”

intelligence.title: Configure Intelligence
intelligence.summary: Choose the right model or tool for each capability instead of one global model.
intelligence.example: Use a strong model for reasoning, but a lower-cost one for everyday chat.
intelligence.guide: Intelligence is configured per capability. Start with a preset or customize chat, reasoning, vision, transcription, image and video generation, web search, and data tools separately. Configure provider keys in Access or use prepaid credits.
intelligence.note: Adding a provider key does not select that provider automatically. A selected tool must also have a usable provider key, prepaid credits, or sponsored access.

behavior.title: Shape profile and chat behavior
behavior.summary: Separate account-wide context from rules that belong to one chat.
behavior.example: Remember what I do everywhere, but keep one group chat concise.
behavior.guide: Profile stores your name, background, and personal instructions across chats. Each chat can separately control context, history depth, output length, reasoning limits, and media behavior. Group-wide controls require chat-administrator permission.
behavior.note: Private chats always reply when addressed. Group reply likelihood and shared chat settings are available only where the platform and your administrator role allow them.

capabilities.title: Work beyond text
capabilities.summary: Use search, media, generation, monitoring, and group tools from chat.
capabilities.example: Watch this topic, alert me when it changes, and summarize the source.
capabilities.guide: Send text, images, voice messages, or documents and describe the outcome. The Agent can search, analyze, transcribe, create or edit media, and monitor supported topics when the required capability is configured.
capabilities.note: Availability depends on the chat platform, selected tool, provider access, and deployment. If a capability is unavailable, check Intelligence and Access first.

costs.title: Understand credits and costs
costs.summary: See what paid for each task and choose how future usage is funded.
costs.example: Show me what used credits this month and which tools caused it.
costs.guide: Buy prepaid credits in Purchases or supply your own provider keys in Access. Usage shows the payer, provider, purpose, token or runtime details, transfers, sponsored usage, and failed calls.
costs.note: Costs vary by model and content. Search can create more than one billed query. Failed calls remain visible but do not deduct credits, and detailed usage is retained for 30 days.

sponsorships.title: Sponsor another person
sponsorships.summary: Fund someone else's Agent use without sharing accounts or private data.
sponsorships.example: Give a family member access without sharing my provider keys.
sponsorships.guide: A sponsor can fund another profile by platform handle without sharing accounts, keys, settings, or chats. The sponsor needs credits or at least one provider key. New recipients accept by starting the Agent.
sponsorships.note: Self-sponsoring, sponsorship chains, and recipients with provider keys or an existing sponsor are not eligible. A pending sponsorship expires after 30 days and can be revoked.

profiles.title: Connect Telegram and WhatsApp
profiles.summary: Merge two cross-platform profiles into one Agent identity.
profiles.example: Use one account and balance across Telegram and WhatsApp.
profiles.guide: Open My key on one profile, then enter that key from the other platform's profile. Telegram and WhatsApp profiles can merge across platforms; credits, messages, alerts, and sponsorship relationships are combined.
profiles.note: The merge is consequential: the older profile wins conflicting settings, the other account is removed, and the connection key rotates. Review both profiles before continuing.
